reviews.comment: This Professor assigned book work two days after the syllabus was released. I cant afford Aggie bookstore textbooks, and was going to receive a lower grade because of it. Her integrity would have been ruined, if she pushed the assignment back a day. She told me to accept a low grade. I would recommend/wait for the other professor!

Pretty lazy prof. Count on the textbook to teach you things, because in class you either watch youtube videos or go over poorly made powerpoints. She showed up to class late often and she talked about things that does not pertain to the class. I can interview someone just the same as I did before taking this class. Didn't learn much

Ms. Jackson was very kind and cared about her students a lot. Major grades are 4 interviews you do with peers, and other grades are from outlines, discussion posts, etc. Have to read once in a while but not every week. She doesn't respond that quickly to emails so ask questions in class or email her early.
